@s1 stated
  relation "land in"
  role subject "the user"
  role location "Stansted"
  role time "Monday"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "sign"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the lease"
  role location "Kaplan Lettings"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "open"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "an account"
  role location "Monzo"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "receive"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "NI number"
  role time "Tuesday morning"
  role instrument "by post"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "open"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "an account"
      role location "Monzo"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "sign"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "the lease"
      role location "Kaplan Lettings"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  order ?t1 before ?t2

@q2 query
  where all
    match
      relation "open"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "an account"
      role location "Monzo"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "sign"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "the lease"
      role location "Kaplan Lettings"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  order ?t1 after ?t2
